common_issues: All ingredient names missing _raw / form suffix - universal blocker (potato → potato_raw, tomato → tomato_raw, ghee → ghee_raw, etc.)
'turmeric powder' → 'turmeric_powder_raw', 'red chilli powder' → 'red_chilli_powder_raw', 'garam masala' → 'garam_masala_raw' (spaces to underscores)
Rajma Masala: vegan tag retained correctly (uses sunflower oil, not ghee) but missing 'bay_leaf_raw' which is canonical to punjabi rajma - minor
Chole Masala: missing tea leaves / bay leaf / cinnamon for authentic deep colour - minor, not blocker
Jeera Rice: 200g rice for 4 servings = 50g/serving, fits grain range; allergen 'dairy' correctly tagged due to ghee
display_unit 'inch' and 'clove' are not in allowed list (katori, cup, tbsp, tsp, piece, glass, roti, g, ml) - convert to 'piece' or 'tsp'
Per-serving portions and kcal generally within lunch band (400-700)
Recipe structure, instructions, and cuisine assignments are accurate
